stories.title: US spot Bitcoin ETFs near record monthly outflow of $3.5 billion
stories.summary: US spot Bitcoin ETFs saw about $3.5 billion in outflows this month. That is close to the record monthly outflow, which sits roughly $1 billion higher. The figure shows investors pulling money out of these funds at an unusually fast pace.
stories.whyItMatters: ETF flows are a key gauge of institutional demand for Bitcoin, and outflows this large point to cooling institutional appetite.
whatToWatch: Whether outflows set a new monthly record before the month ends
The next monthly ETF flow report
questions: What is driving the pullback from Bitcoin ETFs?

stories.title: Bitcoin falls to four-month low as $820 million in positions get liquidated
stories.summary: Bitcoin dropped to a four-month low. Traders lost $820 million in liquidated positions, and analysts flagged a $12.7 billion short squeeze risk building in the market. The decline comes alongside the biggest drop in stablecoin supply since 2022, which may limit how much cash buyers have ready to deploy. Separate commentary noted Bitcoin missed the 85% rally in AI stocks this year, raising the question of whether it could still take a hit if that rally unwinds.
stories.whyItMatters: Large liquidations and a shrinking stablecoin supply affect how much ready capital exists to buy the dip, a key signal for reading the current sell-off.
whatToWatch: Whether the $12.7 billion short squeeze materializes
Stablecoin supply trends in the coming days
Further liquidation cascades if price keeps falling
questions: Is the stablecoin supply drop temporary or a longer trend?
Would a reversal in AI stocks really spill over into Bitcoin?

stories.title: Bitcoin crashes to $59,000 as Anthropic stock falls 25% from its IPO-day high
stories.summary: Bitcoin fell to $59,000. The drop followed a 25% fall in Anthropic's stock from the high it hit on its IPO day. CryptoSlate linked the two moves but did not detail the mechanism connecting them.
stories.whyItMatters: A reported link between a hot AI stock's post-IPO slide and Bitcoin's price points to closer correlation between crypto and speculative tech equities.
whatToWatch: Whether Bitcoin and Anthropic shares keep moving together
Any further declines in either market
questions: What explains the correlation between Anthropic's stock and Bitcoin's price?
Is this a one-day event or a longer trend?

stories.title: Ethereum still targets December test for Glamsterdam upgrade despite 200 open findings
stories.summary: Ethereum developers plan to test the Glamsterdam upgrade in December. Reviewers have logged 200 findings that could delay the rollout. The report does not say how severe the findings are or who raised them.
stories.whyItMatters: Delays or complications in a major upgrade affect Ethereum's technical roadmap and anyone building on or holding ETH.
whatToWatch: Whether the 200 findings get resolved in time

stories.title: DeFi protocol now powers $1.6 billion of Coinbase's crypto loans
stories.summary: A DeFi protocol sits behind $1.6 billion in loans issued through Coinbase. CryptoSlate frames this as a sign that crypto lending is moving into the mainstream, with a major regulated exchange relying on decentralized infrastructure.
stories.whyItMatters: It shows a large regulated exchange building directly on DeFi rails, blurring the line between centralized and decentralized finance.
whatToWatch: Growth in the loan volume over time
Whether other exchanges adopt similar DeFi-backed lending
questions: Which protocol is it, and what are its risk controls?
How does Coinbase manage counterparty and smart-contract risk here?

stories.title: AI data center boom linked to 650 premature US deaths from pollution
stories.summary: A report connects the growth of AI data centers to an estimated 650 premature deaths in the US. The pollution impact reportedly spreads across multiple states. The source does not give the methodology behind the estimate.
stories.whyItMatters: Not a crypto-market story, but it signals growing scrutiny of data center energy and environmental costs, a cost structure that also applies to crypto mining.
whatToWatch: Any regulatory response to data center pollution
Further studies on the health impact

stories.title: Coinbase launches crypto options in a market Deribit dominates
stories.summary: Coinbase opened a crypto options market. CryptoSlate notes that options trading makes up a small share, about 2%, of overall trading volume at Deribit, the exchange that dominates crypto options today. Coinbase's entry adds a major regulated venue to that market.
stories.whyItMatters: Options are a key tool for hedging and speculation, so a major US-regulated exchange entering the space could shift where institutional traders execute options.
whatToWatch: Competitive response from Deribit and other options venues
questions: Can Coinbase meaningfully take share from Deribit?
What products will Coinbase offer first?
